name: TAGLUS PREMIUM
tagline: Superior material properties and enhanced esthetics
overview: Taglus Premium is an innovative aligner and retainer material with superior material properties and enhanced esthetics. As a unique engineering combination of elasticity with matchless rigidity and crack resistance, it offers optical clarity along with stain resistance.
propertiesIntro: In applications where plastic films are designed to withstand orthodontic forces in an aligner, the mechanical properties of polymers namely Strength, Stiffness & Toughness play a vital role. TAGLUS Premium has unique balance of rigidity with elasticity.
testingNote: Tested by an NABL accredited laboratory complying with ISO/IEC 17025 Laboratory Management System.

features.title: ULTRA-TRANSPARENT SHEETS
features.description: Light transmission of 91% as per ASTM D 1003 for high cosmetic clarity.

features.title: BEST-IN-CLASS MECHANICAL PROPERTIES
features.description: High tensile modulus and balanced flexural strength preventing crack formation.

features.title: PREDICTABLE TOOTH MOVEMENT
features.description: Delivers gentle yet consistent sustained force vectors over treatment duration.

features.title: DUAL PROTECTIVE MASKING
features.description: Ultra-thin peel-away masking on both sides prevents contamination prior to thermoforming.

faqs.answer: Taglus Premium sheets have a shelf life of up to 3 years when stored in their original sealed protective packaging away from direct heat and UV exposure.
faqs.question: What is the shelf life of taglus premium?

faqs.answer: Yes, Taglus Premium is certified under MDR IIa and ISO standards, distributed across North America, Europe, Asia, and Latin America.
faqs.question: Is Taglus Premium distributed globally?

name: TAGLUS® PU FLEX
tagline: Smartest material properties and enhanced esthetics
overview: Taglus® PU Flex is a homogeneous polyurethane sheet that consists of linear polymeric chains made of alternating flexible and rigid segments.
propertiesIntro: Investigated using ASTM D 638: 2014. Taglus® PU Flex demonstrates high tensile stress at break (~61 MPa), offering ideal balance between flexibility and rigidity.
testingNote: The test was performed by an NABL accredited laboratory complying with ISO/IEC 17025 Laboratory Management System.

features.title: HIGHLY FLEXIBLE
features.description: Unique polymer formulation results in higher toughness yet significantly more flexibility for patient comfort.

features.title: COMFORTABLE AND DURABLE
features.description: High value of elongation at break dramatically reduces the risk of aligner cracks and premature clinical failure.

features.title: SUSTAINED KINETIC FORCES
features.description: Delivers sustained orthodontic forces over treatment periods without rapid relaxation degradation.

features.title: EXCELLENT ADAPTATION
features.description: Precise thermoforming adaptation into interproximal dental areas without thinning excessively.

faqs.answer: Taglus PU Flex combines elastomeric polyurethane segments that absorb masticatory stress while applying continuous biological force to target tooth positions.
faqs.question: What makes Taglus PU Flex different?

faqs.answer: Yes, its high elasticity allows it to engage deep undercuts without tearing or causing excessive patient discomfort.
faqs.question: Is it suitable for severe misalignments?

name: TAGLUS® TUFF
overview: Taglus® Tuff is an uniaxially oriented amorphous material with polymer chains locked together in a non-specific lattice structure to maximize durability.
propertiesIntro: Standardized tests under ASTM D 638: 2014 demonstrate that TAGLUS Tuff sheets achieve exceptional break strength.
testingNote: Tested by an NABL accredited laboratory complying with ISO/IEC 17025 Laboratory Management System.

features.title: ULTRA THIN PROFILE
features.description: Delivers maximum retention strength with an ultra-thin 0.80 mm profile.

features.title: HIGH BREAK RESISTANCE
features.description: High break strength of 59 MPa prevents accidental fractures during long-term retainer wear.

features.title: BRUXISM DEFENSE
features.description: Amorphous lattice structure engineered to resist nocturnal grind wear and surface micro-cracking.

features.title: DIMENSIONAL STABILITY
features.description: Zero moisture absorption retention maintaining shape integrity across extended clinical retention cycles.

faqs.answer: Its uniaxially oriented amorphous formulation gives it superior fracture resistance, making it virtually indestructible under normal retainer wear and nocturnal bruxism.
faqs.question: What makes Taglus Tuff ideal for retainers?

faqs.answer: Because of its high molecular stability and resistance to intraoral moisture, retainers made with Taglus Tuff maintain their fit and retention over long-term protocols.
faqs.question: How long can a patient wear a Taglus Tuff retainer?

name: TAGLUS 3D PRINT MODEL RESIN
tagline: High-precision DLP/LCD 3D printing resin with smooth matte finish for dental models
overview: Taglus Model Resin is engineered for high-precision, high-accuracy digital dental model making. Featuring high form and break stability, it offers superior resistance to abrasion, moisture, and light, making it the ideal choice for aligner, orthodontic, and crown & bridge models.
propertiesIntro: Formulated for open DLP, LCD, and SLA printers operating between 385nm and 405nm. Delivers crisp margins, non-brittle toughness, and optimal thermal resistance during thermoforming.
testingNote: Benchmarked and tested for rigorous orthodontic workflows and high-speed thermoforming protocols.

features.title: LIQUID & LOW VISCOSITY
features.description: Easy to clean with low viscosity, enabling faster tank resets and smooth resin flow.

features.title: ODOURLESS & SAFE
features.description: No irritating fumes or volatile monomers. Safe and comfortable laboratory working environment.

features.title: MINIMAL SHRINKAGE
features.description: Exceptional dimensional accuracy with minimal shrinkage post-curing for exact orthodontic fits.

features.title: HARD BUT TOUGH
features.description: Not brittle. Easily withstands high thermoforming pressures, high impact forces, and drills.

features.title: HEAT & MOISTURE RESISTANT
features.description: Maintains high structural integrity and zero deformation under aligner pressure thermoforming.

features.title: COST EFFECTIVE
features.description: Affordable digital dental production solution designed for commercial labs and clinical workflows.

faqs.answer: Taglus Model Resin works seamlessly with standard open-material DLP, LCD, and SLA 3D printers operating at 385nm to 405nm wavelengths.
faqs.question: Which 3D printers are compatible with Taglus Model Resin?

faqs.answer: Yes, it is specially formulated with high heat and pressure resistance so models won't warp or deform during vacuum and pressure forming.
faqs.question: Can Taglus printed models withstand aligner thermoforming?

name: TAGLUS AUTOMATED THERMOFORMING MACHINE ROLL
tagline: Increase production capacity while reducing material cost up to 73%
overview: Taglus aligner and retainer rolls are engineered specifically for automated high-speed thermoforming machines. Validated by industry-leading equipment including HAMER and ALVY Systems, they deliver consistent optical clarity, zero-stress thermoforming, and precision clinical adaptation across large-scale aligner production lines.
propertiesIntro: Engineered to withstand rigorous automated feed cycles and high-pressure forming without thinning or thermal stress fractures.
testingNote: Validated and certified by HAMER and ALVY Systems for automated thermoforming operations.

features.title: INTERNATIONALLY CERTIFIED MATERIAL
features.description: Manufactured under ISO 13485:2016 standards with global biocompatibility approvals for aligner manufacturing.

features.title: AVAILABLE IN PU & PETG
features.description: Offered across our entire material science portfolio including Taglus PU Flex, Premium, Standard, and TUFF formulations.

features.title: HIGH-PRESSURE OPTIMIZATION
features.description: Engineered specifically to produce uniform wall thickness and crisp margins under positive pressure forming systems.

features.title: UP TO 73% COST REDUCTION
features.description: Continuous roll-fed automation eliminates individual sheet handling, maximizing operational yield and drastically cutting per-aligner material waste.

faqs.answer: Taglus Automated Thermoforming Rolls are officially validated and optimized for HAMER, ALVY Systems, and other high-volume automated pressure forming equipment.
faqs.question: Which automated thermoforming machines are compatible with Taglus rolls?

faqs.answer: Rolls are available in Taglus PU Flex (0.76 mm & 1.02 mm), Taglus Premium (0.76 mm & 1.02 mm), Taglus Standard (0.76 mm & 1.02 mm), and Taglus TUFF (0.80 mm).
faqs.question: What material formulations are available in roll format?

name: TAGLUS® ULTRA
tagline: More force. More control. More movement.
overview: A high-force aligner sheet engineered for demanding orthodontic cases and accelerated treatment timelines. Some cases need more: moderate to severe crowding, significant rotations and challenging bite corrections require a material that delivers higher, sustained orthodontic forces without sacrificing clarity or comfort. Available for sale only in Asia Pacific, Europe and South America.
propertiesIntro: A high-force aligner sheet for demanding orthodontic cases: higher, sustained forces with high optical clarity and precise thermoforming adaptation.

features.title: High Force Delivery
features.description: Formulated to generate stronger initial forces than standard aligner materials, delivering more tooth movement per step for demanding cases.

features.title: Superior Clarity
features.description: Maintains high optical clarity throughout the wear cycle while delivering higher orthodontic forces.

features.title: Precision Fit
features.description: Excellent adaptation during thermoforming, including tight interproximal spaces and complex posterior anatomy.

features.title: Biocompatible & Certified
features.description: CE & TGA certified. BPA free and suitable for intraoral use throughout the treatment.

faqs.answer: Both are high-performance aligner materials, but they serve different clinical needs. PU Flex is optimised for flexibility, patient comfort, and sustained gentle force across all cases. Ultra is formulated for higher force output, making it the choice for complex cases requiring more aggressive tooth movement per step.
faqs.question: How does Ultra differ from PU Flex?
